injuries.description: Retained surgical pad (surgical swab) inside the abdomen
source: A surgical pad used in this operation was left inside the Plaintiff's abdomen and only removed by operation over 20 years later on 28th August 1987.

injuries.description: Chronic subphrenic abscess surrounding the retained surgical pad
source: He confirmed that a chronic subphrenic abscess and an abdominal surgical pad was later removed from a space above the Plaintiff's liver.

injuries.description: Calcification of tissue (calcified material / calcified wall) associated with the abscess
source: a sinogram taken after the removal of the foreign body and abscess revealed a cavity the size of a grapefruit where the calcified material had laid (P.25 in Bundle of Documents).

manifestations.description: She had a little pain on her side near her stomach.
The pain she felt in 1975 was in the same area but was more severe and she likened the pain to what she had experienced prior to her gall bladder operation.
The pain she felt after her operation did interfere with her work as a vegetable farmer at Wong Chuk Hang and she was only able to work when she did not feel the pain.
She was unable to do her housework or to have a good sleep when she felt severe pain.
She still feels some pain but that it is an improvement on her previous condition and does not interfere with her housework or sleep.
The arching of the Plaintiff's right diaphragm as seen on the x-rays was caused by the fibrous tissue containing the surgical pad.

treatments_received: Surgical removal of retained surgical pad by Dr. Frank Cheng (operation on 28 August 1987)
Admission for 5 days' observation in August 1987 and subsequent hospital admission until 11 September 1987
CT scan (27 August 1987 and earlier CT scan in 1983)
Repeated intramuscular/intravenous injections (reticulose and essentiale) over many years (1,300 injections recorded)

losses.description: Forced to give up vegetable farming due to pain associated with the condition.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Affected ability to do housework and to take rest and sleep over a long period.
Residual pain and discomfort and impairment of abdominal area resulting from retained surgical pad and chronic abscess with calcification.
